Operating as an individual contributor and principal technical authority, you will define, deliver, and operate technology solutions to power the systems, applications, APIs, and infrastructure meeting the rapidly evolving needs of a worldwide payment network.

You will set technical and UI architecture strategies, establish modern frontend/API standards, evaluate third-party supplier solutions, and define pragmatic destination architectures with clear waypoint solutions. You will have the opportunity to leverage cutting-edge automation, including AI-native and agentic engineering solutions at scale, to drastically accelerate these modernization efforts and streamline connectivity across a high-volume, low-latency, and highly resilient distributed ecosystem.

Within this global B2B client ecosystem, you will design and architect solutions across the full commercial lifecycle, supporting merchants, acquirers, payment gateways, and card issuers. Your scope spans Marketing & Engagement (public sites, prospect portals, marketing tools), Sales Enablement (prospect management, market intelligence, referrals), and Contract Management & Due Diligence (automated workflows, AI-assisted contract insights, risk/KYC assessments, contract execution). You will streamline client interaction across multiple payment network schemes while championing the user interfaces, system integrations, and automated capabilities that service both internal Capital One associates and external network participant teams.
